ttsScriptEn: Let's begin. Please introduce yourself. Talk about what you do, where you spend most of your day, and one interest that is important to you.
Tell me about the place where you live. Describe the rooms, the atmosphere, and what you usually do there when you have free time.
Think about a memorable moment you had at home. What happened, who was with you, and why do you still remember it?
Describe an electronic device you use often. Explain what it looks like, how you use it, and why it is useful in your daily life.
Compare how you used technology a few years ago with how you use it now. What has changed, and how has that change affected your routine?
Talk about a kind of music you enjoy. Describe when you usually listen to it, how it makes you feel, and one artist or song you like.
Tell me about a live event, performance, movie, or show that you remember well. Describe where it was, what happened, and what made it memorable.
Describe an exercise or outdoor activity you do, or would like to do. Explain how often you do it, where you do it, and how you feel afterward.
Compare your free-time activities now with the activities you enjoyed when you were younger. What is different, and what has stayed the same?
I will give you a situation. You want to make a dinner reservation at a restaurant this weekend. Call the restaurant and ask three or four questions about availability, menu options, and seating.
Now you have a problem. You made a reservation, but your schedule suddenly changed. Call the restaurant, explain the problem, and suggest a new time or another solution.
Tell me about a time when a plan changed unexpectedly during a trip, meeting, or personal event. Explain what went wrong, what you did, and what you learned from the experience.
This is a test question. Please say your name and describe one thing you did today.
